 .;This routine is responsible for managing the display and
 .;interaction logic for inpatient visit records within the
 .;Veterans Health Information Systems and Technology Architecture
 .;(VistA). It ensures that users can view, sort, and select
 .;inpatient records efficiently.
 .;

3e858546: Insert the charged date into the display and update the temp global
23ee43a8: Cleanup temporary variables

60944183:  .; This routine handles the editing of discharge summaries and other documents.
 .; Depending on the document type, a specific edit sequence is followed.
 .; For discharge summaries, a custom edit sequence is used.
 .; For other document types, a standard edit sequence is followed.
3379fe8e: ; For non-discharge summary documents, edit in the standard sequence unless an interrupt or timeout occurs.
00d4d70f: ; For discharge summaries, follow a custom edit sequence to accommodate specific requirements.
031711d5: ; End of routine.
